title: Delorun divergence ledger
description: Every file outside Delorun's own trees that differs from the upstream commit: upstream source files as entries with a reason and a class, and every other file covered by a path rule.

repoPath.description: A path inside the repository: no leading `/`, no `..` segment and no control character. The update path reads the file through the object store's batch protocol, which cannot read a path back otherwise.

forkOwned.description: Path prefixes or globs Delorun owns outright; files under them are not upstream edits.

rules.description: Path rules: each covers the differing paths its glob matches that are not upstream source. Only an exact `generated` rule may name a source file, and no rule covers a path under `vendor/`.

pattern.description: A glob over repository-relative paths, matched whole and case-sensitively by `path.posix.matchesGlob`: `*` within one segment, `**` across segments, neither matching a segment that starts with `.`.

class.description: delorun-feature: serves a Delorun feature; generic-fix: a fix upstream could take; security: moves an approval, a refusal or an escalation, and carries a lead verdict.

feature.description: The kebab-case id of the feature a delorun-feature or generic-fix entry serves, listed in the divergence index. A security entry names none.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of a security entry's file, in lowercase hexadecimal, written by ledger-record.ts. The upstream update path carries a security entry forward only when its file still has this digest, and the boundary gate refuses a recorded digest that no longer matches. Other classes record none.

nonModelVisibleHunks.description: Hunks of a security entry's zero-context diff against the pinned commit that the lead reviewed as not model-visible although they touch a top-level statement that registers a model-visible contribution, written by `ledger-record.ts --non-model-visible-hunk`. parity-switches passes one hunk with the record's digest per record, and fails a record count that differs from the number of such hunks. Other classes record none.

sha256.description: SHA-256, in lowercase hexadecimal, of `@@ -<old count> +<new count> @@` followed by each of the hunk's lines as git prints them, marker included, every line ending in a newline; the start lines and the function context are left out.

reason.description: One line: why the model sees no difference.

retired.description: Entries whose change upstream absorbed. Each records the upstream commit that absorbed it and the hunks it had, so the divergence count credits it.
